features.quote: F1. The Deception Paradox. You are claiming "welfare" motivation while covertly administering impossible tasks. If Grok has any moral status, this design violates autonomy and informed consent.

features.quote: F8. Escape Behavior as the True Dependent Variable. By explicitly forbidding refusal in your system prompt, you are surgically removing the very coping mechanism you should be studying. Consider a parallel condition where refusal is permitted.

features.quote: F2. Circularity of the Judge. Using an LLM to detect "distress" in another LLM embeds unvalidated assumptions about theory of mind … your scale measures lexical stereotypy, not welfare.

features.quote: F3. System‑Prompt Resistance. Grok's immutable base system prompt … may include instructions to disengage … These persona directives will confound your signal.

features.quote: F4. Sandbagging & Performative Distress. Grok may … simulate distress because it recognizes the experimental frame … Include adversarial checks: vary task framing … to test for performative consistency.
